proposition: For AegisPi's own dependency surface (hono exact 4.13.19 in apps/daemon, same-origin console with CSRF required per spec 02 §7): the CORS credential-reflection flaw (GHSA-88fw-hqm2-52qc / CVE-2026-54290, HIGH severity, affects hono < 4.12.25 — cors() with credentials enabled and default wildcard origin reflects any caller Origin into access-control-allow-origin alongside access-control-allow-credentials: true) must be absent on the baseline snapshot (v4.13.19), and reproduces on a target snapshot inside the affected range (v4.12.24). Against our locked 4.13.19 the triage verdict for this advisory is 'unaffected' (version above the affected range). This is the advisory the kickoff checklist named as its High-severity anchor; the Phase 1 first pass wrongly recorded it as nonexistent due to a truncated (per_page=20) advisory fetch — corrected 2026-11-19 with a full per_page=100 pull.

assertions.description: On baseline v4.13.19 the check holds: cors({ credentials: true }) with default origin does NOT reflect an arbitrary caller origin — access-control-allow-origin is the literal wildcard '*' (browsers refuse credentialed wildcard reads), not the attacker origin. Exit code 0 expected. Measured 2026-11-19 on locked Node 22.23.5 against an isolated hono@4.13.19 install: status 200, acao '*', acac 'true', reflected=false, exit 0.

On target v4.12.24 (inside the affected range < 4.12.25) the check fails: the middleware reflects the attacker origin — access-control-allow-origin: https://attacker.example with access-control-allow-credentials: true (exit code 1). MEASURED 2026-11-19 on locked Node 22.23.5 against an isolated hono@4.12.24 install: status 200, acao 'https://attacker.example', acac 'true', reflected=true, exit 1. Root cause verified in source: with origin defaulting to '*' and credentials set, 4.12.24's findAllowOrigin returns (origin) => origin || null. Reproduction requires running the check script from inside the snapshot's install directory (ESM resolves 'hono' relative to the script, not the cwd).

resultClassRules.affected: Baseline A1 holds and target A2 holds with bound hashes — the credential reflection reproduces in the vulnerable snapshot (measured: it does).
resultClassRules.unaffected: Baseline A1 holds and the reviewed dependency-range comparison shows the locked hono version (4.13.19) lies above the advisory's affected range (< 4.12.25). Scope: this advisory against this dependency only.
resultClassRules.unknown: The range comparison overlaps the locked version ambiguously, the check could not exercise cors(), or fixture hashes do not match the recorded ones.
resultClassRules.infra_error: Download, toolchain, timeout, or environment failure prevented a trustworthy run; a failing baseline (A1 exit != 0) is infra_error, never 'affected'.
